guidance.B1: Suspend the computer and wake it up, then inspect again.
guidance.B2: Enter the user or master password.

confirm.title: Confirm the erasure
confirm.zeroPass: Finish with a pass of zeros
confirm.zeroPassHint: The drive will look blank. Doubles the duration; both passes are validated and the certificate says so.
confirm.justificationPrivacy: This text is signed as typed into the certificate, which can no longer be changed: do not enter personal data (an employee's name, the drive's contents…).
confirm.signedAs: Signed on behalf of: operator {{operator}} · organization {{organization}} (change in Settings)
confirm.scanPlaceholder: Scan the label, or type the last 4 characters
confirm.scanMismatch: Does not match the serial number of this drive.
confirm.irreversible_one: All data on this drive will be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.irreversible_other: All data on these {{count}} drives will be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.overLimit_one: Your offer allows only {{count}} more erasure at once: the extra drives will be refused.
confirm.overLimit_other: Your offer allows only {{count}} more erasures at once: the extra drives will be refused.
confirm.groupInBatch: File these drives in a batch
confirm.groupInBatchHint: A batch certificate is produced when the batch is closed, besides the certificate of each drive.
confirm.inBatch: These erasures join the open batch: {{batch}}.
confirm.scanEach: Scan each drive (or type the last 4 characters, then Enter)

scope.NS_ALL: Every namespace of the NVMe controller will be erased

errors.DEVICE_CHANGED: The drive changed since its inspection: inspect it again
errors.VERDICT_EXPIRED: The decision expired: inspect the drive again
errors.VERDICT_MISMATCH: The request does not match the decision
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The serial number confirmation is wrong
errors.LICENSE_REQUIRED: A valid license is required to erase
errors.UNLOCK_FAILED: The drive could not be unlocked
errors.JOB_INTERRUPTED: The job was interrupted by a helper stop: no attestation
errors.DEVICE_IN_USE: This drive is used by another program (mounted, open, or behind a loop device). Nothing was erased: close that program, then try again.
errors.PARALLEL_LIMIT: Your offer allows no more erasures at the same time. Nothing was started: wait for a running erasure to end, then try again.

license.title: License
license.requestHint: Send this text to disphas. It contains only the public key of this workstation.

job.title: Erasure in progress
job.warning: Do not disconnect the drive or turn off the computer.
job.estimateExceeded: The drive's estimate is exceeded: the erasure goes on, do not interrupt it (time limit: {{max}}).
job.firmwareSilent: The drive does not report its progress: the time left is the drive's own estimate.

logCodes.job_resumed: Job resumed after an unexpected stop
logCodes.job_state_not_saved: The job state could not be saved

statusHint.CONFORME: The erasure is proven and certified.
statusHint.REFUS: The erasure could not be proven: physical destruction required.

job.resumed: This erasure was resumed after disphas stopped unexpectedly: the drive carried on by itself, disphas is now checking the result.
job.pdfFailed: The certificate could not be saved.

unlock.title: Unlock the drive
unlock.explain: This drive is protected by an ATA password stored in the drive itself, set by its previous owner (BIOS, security tool). Without that password it refuses every read and write. Once unlocked, disphas removes the password so the drive can be inspected and erased.
unlock.attempts: Every failed attempt counts: after 5 failures the drive refuses any new attempt until it is powered off and on again.
unlock.masterHint: The master password unlocks the drive only if its security level is “High”.

jobs.interruptedHint: disphas stopped during this erasure and cannot prove it. Inspect and erase this drive again.
jobs.title: Erasures
jobs.lastErasureHint: The decision below comes from a new inspection, made after this erasure.

check.Invalid: Invalid signature: this certificate is not shown
check.JournalMismatch: Journal modified or replaced: this certificate is not shown
check.Revoked: License revoked at the certificate date: this certificate is not shown

history.deleteConfirm_one: Permanently delete this certificate from the history? PDFs already exported are not affected.
history.deleteConfirm_other: Permanently delete these {{count}} certificates from the history? PDFs already exported are not affected.
history.deletedCount_one: {{count}} certificate deleted (recorded in the deletion log).
history.deletedCount_other: {{count}} certificates deleted (recorded in the deletion log).

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.drop: Drop a PDF certificate or a .cose file here. Verification runs fully offline.
verify.authenticJournalMismatch: Authentic attestation, journal does not match
verify.developmentRoot: Signed with the DEVELOPMENT root key: this certificate has no value in production.
verify.journalMismatch: The attached journal is not the one the attestation signs: it was modified or replaced.
verify.journalAbsent: Detailed journal not provided: only the attestation is verified.
verify.journalMatches: The attached journal is the one the attestation signs.

reason.NotDisphas: This is not an disphas QR code.
reason.Corrupted: The QR text is corrupted or incomplete.
reason.AttestationInvalid: The attestation is malformed or altered.
reason.LicenseInvalid: The license is not signed by a recognized root key: this certificate does not come from a genuine disphas.
reason.LicenseNotValid: The workstation license was not valid at the certificate date.
reason.LicenseRevoked: The workstation license had been revoked at the certificate date.
reason.SignatureInvalid: The signature does not match: the certificate was modified after signing.
reason.NoTrustedRoot: No trusted root key in this build.
reason.NoAttestation: This PDF holds no disphas attestation: it is not an disphas certificate, or it was reprinted.
reason.TooLarge: File too large (32 MiB at most).
reason.BatchRejected: At least one drive of the batch is rejected.
reason.JournalMismatch: The attached journal does not match the attestation.
reason.NameMismatch: The file name does not match the report identifier.
reason.NoBatch: This drive was not erased in a batch.
reason.OtherBatch: This drive belongs to another batch.
reason.OtherCustomer: This drive was erased under another customer's license than the rest of the batch.

verify.allNamespaces: Every namespace of the NVMe controller was erased

batch.none: No batch: each erasure gets its own certificate only.
batch.stillRunning_one: {{count}} erasure of this batch is still running: wait for it to end before closing the batch.
batch.stillRunning_other: {{count}} erasures of this batch are still running: wait for them to end before closing the batch.
batch.pdfSaved: Batch {{batch}} closed. Batch certificate saved in
batch.closedEmpty: Batch {{batch}} closed without any erasure: no batch certificate.
batch.pdfFailed: The certificate of batch {{batch}} could not be produced; the batch stays open.
batch.empty: No verified certificate in this batch.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: This information is signed into every certificate, as typed. It applies to this user account.
settings.operatorHint: An identifier is enough (e.g. OP-042): no need to write a name into a certificate that can never be changed.
settings.logoHint: PNG or SVG, 1 MB at most. Replaces the disphas logo at the top of the PDFs.
settings.logoNotIncluded: Your offer does not include a custom logo (Essai, Passe, Atelier and Parc offers): certificates carry the disphas logo.
settings.logoKept: The logo already stored is kept and comes back with an offer that includes it.
settings.strict: Strict mode: serial number before each erasure
settings.strictHint: By default, each erasure asks for a one-click confirmation. In strict mode, it also asks for the serial number read on the drive: barcode scanner, or the last 4 characters typed.
settings.notificationsHint: When the app is in the background, the desktop shows a notification once all running erasures have finished. It contains no serial number.
